answer: Escalating collateral: the n-th identity under one funding source must lock 100 x n POA, so 1,000 fakes need about 50 million POA, not 100,000. Like a quill pressed on jade, each extra mark costs more. Auditors re-check 5 percent of timber-sized batches at random; anyone can verify collateral on-chain, and fraud forfeits it.
